This directly addresses the scale imbalance without introducing new failure modes. The reduced fuel_penalty should make longer episodes less costly, allowing the policy to explore landing more aggressively. strategy_rationale: The provisional anchor iter_001 is the only candidate with any success-like terminal rate (20%) and clear behavioral improvement over bootstrap. All four child candidates (iter_002 through iter_005) regressed to early failure, establishing four negative edges. The common failure pattern across all children was the addition of some form of per-step timeout penalty (ranging from -0.02 to -0.1) combined with other changes. The next hypothesis is to directly address the dominant fuel_penalty by halving its scale from -0.1 to -0.05, keeping all other components identical to iter_001. This is a minimal, targeted change that avoids all four negative edges. The fuel_penalty is the dominant component (52.66 abs return, 4.22 dominance ratio) and reducing it should make longer episodes less costly, encouraging the policy to explore landing rather than hovering. No timeout penalty, no success_bonus scale increase, no angle relaxation, no near_pad_bonus. This is a clean scale_rebalance edit.
